analysis.title: Unity Software Inc. (U) Q3'26 Earnings Review: Vector Outperformance Drives Beat & Raise; Longer Term Strategy Coming Into Focus
key_insights: Q3'26 was a strong beat and raise. Total Strategic revenue growth accelerated to +59% YoY and Adj. EBITDA margin expanded +1800bps YoY to 41%.

Unity Vector (Unity Ads) was the growth engine at +126% YoY. GS attributes it to product launches, model improvements and data utilization (Runtime). Vector revenue grew +40% QoQ in Q3, with guidance for +21-23% QoQ growth in Q4.
Broad-based Vector growth in Q3, with advertiser accounts +27% QoQ.

Unity opened the platform to coding agents in early August, and creator DAUs are +25% since then. Unity Spark is a non-exclusive partnership with GOOGL, now in closed beta, with full launch expected in 2027.
Q3'26 was the company's first quarter of GAAP net income profitability. Management guidance assumes further QoQ margin expansion in Q4, driven by prior restructuring and expense discipline.

GS expects near-term investor focus on the linearity of performance, given the unpredictability of model improvements in timing and scope. Next debates are expected on Runtime data integration and on monetization and scaling of Unity Spark into 2027.

Press reports indicate Unity held talks before the earnings report to be acquired by a consortium of investors at a discussed valuation of ~$25bn. GS expresses no opinion on a deal but expects updated reporting to be a potential driver of short-term stock performance.

Negatives: Q4'26 Strategic Create revenue guide of +4-6% YoY implies a modest deceleration vs Q3, against a ~400bps tougher comp, as management takes a long-term approach to Create pricing. FY27 SBC outlook of ~$75mm per quarter is a step-up from $63mm in Q3'26, though management expects SBC to keep declining as a % of revenue.
GS maintains Neutral and raises the 12-month PT to $62 from $50 on higher operating estimates and forward management commentary. The price is $48.80, implying 27.0% upside.
Estimate changes: FY27 revenue raised to $3.26bn from $2.83bn, Adj. EBITDA to $1.46bn from $1.10bn, GAAP EPS to $2.12 from $1.37. Q4'26 revenue raised to $693mm from $604mm.

Valuation blends 7.25x EV/Sales on NTM+1 estimates with a modified DCF using 19.0x EV/GAAP EBITDA (cut from 23.0x) on NTM+4 estimates, discounted 3 years at 12%. The lower EBITDA multiple keeps the ~1.0x multiple-to-growth ratio.

market_movers.rationale: GS maintains Neutral and raises the PT from $50 to $62 after the Q3'26 beat and raise, led by Vector. Estimates rose for Q4'26 and 2027.

earnings_insights: Q3'26 total revenue was $622mm actual vs GS $564mm and consensus (Visible Alpha) $567mm, a beat of 10% vs both. Revenue grew +32% YoY and +14% QoQ.

Q3'26 Grow Solutions revenue was $457mm actual vs GS $403mm and consensus $406mm. Grow-Strategic was $432mm actual vs GS $383mm, consensus $386mm and guidance of $380-385mm. It grew +91% YoY and +31% QoQ.
Q3'26 Create-Strategic revenue was $165mm actual vs GS $161mm, consensus $162mm and guidance of $159-163mm, up +11% YoY.
Q3'26 Adj. EBITDA was $257mm actual (41.2% margin) vs GS $187mm, consensus $186mm and guidance of $185-190mm.
Q3'26 GAAP EBITDA was $186mm actual (29.8% margin) vs GS $104mm and consensus $104mm.
Q3'26 GAAP EPS was $0.25 actual vs GS $0.05 and consensus $0.04. Adj. EPS was $0.44 actual vs GS $0.40 and consensus $0.36.
Q4'26 guidance: Create-Strategic $168-171mm, Grow-Strategic $515-520mm, Grow Non-Strategic $5mm, Adj. EBITDA $290-295mm.
GS new Q4'26 estimates: revenue $693mm (old $604mm), Adj. EBITDA $293mm (old $209mm), GAAP EPS $0.32 (old $0.14), Adj. EPS $0.59 (old $0.43).
GS FY26E: revenue $2,369mm (old $2,223mm), Adj. EBITDA $848mm (old $694mm), Adj. EPS $1.54 (old $1.34), GAAP EPS $(0.20) (old $(0.63)).

GS FY27E: revenue $3,263mm (old $2,826mm), Adj. EBITDA $1,456mm (old $1,101mm), GAAP EPS $2.12 (old $1.37), Adj. EPS $2.84 (old $2.14). FY28E: revenue $3,892mm (old $3,351mm), Adj. EPS $3.44 (old $2.59).
risk_factors: Forward growth outlook in Grow: upside from Vector, downside from competition from other ad monetization platforms.
TAM realization across Create and Grow segments.
Macro environment for global gaming and in-app purchase/advertising spend.
Level of investment in growth initiatives limiting profitability, versus cost savings without compromising growth.
Exposure to global macro volatility and investor risk appetite for growth stocks.
Linearity of Vector performance given unpredictable model improvements.

tension_points.bull_case: Vector grew +126% YoY in Q3'26, with revenue +40% QoQ, advertiser accounts +27% QoQ and a Q4 guide of +21-23% QoQ. GS raised FY27 revenue to $3.26bn from $2.83bn.
tension_points.bear_case: Model improvements are unpredictable in timing and scope, so performance linearity is uncertain. Competition from other ad monetization platforms is a downside risk, and Create-Strategic growth is guided to slow to +4-6% YoY in Q4.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Forward Grow growth outlook and Vector quarterly linearity in coming quarters, which GS names as the key swing factor for the rating.
